summary: Vernal Capital Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units may elect to separately trade the ordinary shares and rights starting May 19, 2026, with the shares and rights trading on the NYSE under VECA and VECAR respectively. This is a standard post-IPO unit separation, not a special situation like a business combination or liquidation. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are involved. The filing is purely administrative, enabling separate trading of the components; there is no risk-arb angle or strategic event to monitor.
